newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Analysts see Danish reserves up in April.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Analysts see Danish reserves up in April.

text.p: Four analysts polled by Reuters in a forecast issued on Thursday foresaw Denmark's foreign reserves rising to an average 100.2 billion crowns at end-April from end-March's 94.4 billion crowns.
The estimates, which excluded net loan transactions, swung from a low 97.4 billion crowns to a high 102.4 billion crowns.
The Danish central bank issues its end-April foreign reserves data on Friday May 2 at 1400 gmt.
